gameConfig.title: Astro Salvage
gameConfig.description: Fly a salvage ship through an asteroid belt, blast rocks into smaller rocks, and chain kills for combo multipliers before your three hulls run out.

sprites.name: ship
sprites.description: 34x40 pixel-art salvage ship, cyan hull with white trim, narrow nose, twin rear fins, facing up

sprites.name: thruster
sprites.description: 14x18 orange-to-yellow flame triangle, flickers behind the ship

sprites.name: bullet
sprites.description: 6x18 pale cyan plasma bolt with rounded caps and a soft glow

sprites.name: rock-big
sprites.description: 56x56 grey irregular asteroid, ten sides, three shadowed craters, dark outline

sprites.name: rock-small
sprites.description: 28x28 lighter grey asteroid shard, eight sides, one crater

sprites.name: pu-spread
sprites.description: 26px glowing green orb with a bright highlight and soft outer halo

sprites.name: pu-shield
sprites.description: 26px glowing indigo orb with a bright highlight and soft outer halo

sprites.name: pu-rapid
sprites.description: 26px glowing amber orb with a bright highlight and soft outer halo

sprites.name: space-bg
sprites.description: Vertical gradient from deep indigo at the top to near-black at the bottom

audio.name: explosion
audio.description: Filtered white-noise burst with a fast decay, 0.35s

audio.name: beltDrone
audio.description: Slow ambient synth pad with a low pulsing bassline, loops seamlessly

keyboard: Arrow keys or WASD to fly
touch: Hold the right FIRE button to auto-fire
mouse: Hold and drag to steer the ship toward the cursor

mechanics.name: Auto-fire with cooldown
mechanics.description: Holding fire shoots continuously on a 220ms cooldown, dropping to 110ms under rapid fire.
mechanics.implementation: Timestamp gate (nextShotAt) checked in update() rather than a setInterval.

mechanics.name: Splitting asteroids
mechanics.description: Big rocks take two hits and split into two small rocks flung left and right; small rocks die in one hit.
mechanics.implementation: Per-sprite hp data value; on death spawnRock({big:false}) twice with opposing x velocities.

mechanics.name: Combo multiplier
mechanics.description: Kills chained within 1.4 seconds raise a multiplier capped at 5x.
mechanics.implementation: lastKillAt timestamp compared against COMBO_WINDOW_MS on each kill.

mechanics.name: Power-up system
mechanics.description: Small rocks drop spread shot, shield, or rapid fire with a 16% chance; each lasts 7 seconds.
mechanics.implementation: Enum-style kind stored on the sprite; expiry via scene.time.delayedCall timers cleared on pickup.

mechanics.name: Object pooling
mechanics.description: Bullets, rocks, and power-ups are recycled instead of created and destroyed.
mechanics.implementation: physics.add.group with maxSize; recycle() disables the body and parks the sprite off-screen.

mechanics.name: Wave escalation
mechanics.description: Every 18 seconds the wave increments and the spawn interval tightens by 6% down to a 380ms floor.
mechanics.implementation: Looping wave timer that rebuilds the spawn timer with the shorter delay.

mechanics.name: Invulnerability window
mechanics.description: Losing a hull grants 1.5s of blinking invulnerability so you cannot be chain-killed.
mechanics.implementation: invulnUntil timestamp checked in the player/rock overlap handler.

monetizationHooks: Interstitial ad every 3rd run on the game-over screen
Rewarded video for a +1 life revive after death
320x50 banner slot reserved on the menu and game-over screens
Coin drip every 500 points plus 2 coins per power-up, feeding a skin shop
mobileOptimizations: Phaser.Scale.FIT with CENTER_BOTH so the canvas fills any viewport
Left virtual joystick with an 18% dead zone
Right FIRE button at a 92px diameter, well over the 44px touch minimum
Multi-touch enabled (input.addPointer) so move and fire work together
Game loop sleeps and audio suspends on visibilitychange
Object pooling keeps active sprites under the 50-sprite budget
High score and coins persisted to localStorage with an in-memory fallback
